Minutes before NodeODM deletes completed or canceled task data. 0 disables NodeODM cleanup so Tapis/Slurm owns lifecycle cleanup.

1 copies the task directory once to the Corral checkpoint root when the task reaches COMPLETED/FAILED/CANCELED (atomic copy, schema 2 manifest). 0 writes manifests only. Operators enable this after staging acceptance.
Whitespace-separated rsync exclude patterns for the terminal checkpoint copy. 3d_tiles/ is always kept; images/ is excluded only when it is an import-path symlink.
Size cap in bytes for the checkpoint root, enforced oldest-first by the prune at job start. 0 disables the cap.
0 (default): a failed checkpoint restore registers with resumeFallbackReason and the job exits without starting a task. 1: fall back to a cold start from NODEODM_RESUME_IMPORT_PATH.
